paragraphs: The V350 was a petrol variant of the V-Class sold during the W447 generation from 2014 until it was discontinued. The V350 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every V350 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the V350 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
